releaseNotes:
• Dynamic Model Discovery: Automatically query provider models (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) upon entering API key
• OpenRouter Free/Paid Categorization: Distinguish free vs paid models with dedicated filter chips and pricing metadata
• Settings Dialog UX: Full swipe-up scrolling for Apply & Close button clear of system navigation bar
• Terminal Tabs: New + Terminal button label and tab close affordances on additional tabs
• Alpine RootFS Setup: Distinct download and reload icons with re-entrant installation guard
• Agent Chat: Vertically centered composer text and streamlined panel layout
